messages:
maria: Heads up — starting ~1905123400 we saw a sharp P95 increase on shard-12 and KV prefix hit-rate collapsed from ~0.78 -> 0.03. Grafana: <link/grafana/chart/kv-hitrate/shard-12>. Not sure yet if noisy tenant or recent coalescing change.
omar: On it. Any recent deploys or config flips in that window?
maria: There was a config flip in staging->prod earlier today: request_coalesce_window_ms bumped from 5 -> 50 in rollout PR #4567 (merged 1905123360). Also a small batching heuristic tweak in kernel-selector: prefer_coalesced_batches=true.
steph: Oof, that coalesce window sounds suspicious — big windows can merge requests from different tenants/prefixes into one batch which might bypass prefix-aligned caching. Do we have KV eviction/alloc logs?
kai: Pulling eviction logs now. Quick snapshot: 
```
kv.cache.shard12.evictions: 1905123455 -> spike to 14k/min
kv.cache.shard12.hitrate: 1905123456 -> 0.03
kv.cache.total_size_mb: 1905123456 -> stable
```
That looks like a working-set churn rather than total size pressure.
nate: I ran a microtrace of a stressed tenant at 1905123460 — coalesced batches contain >500 distinct prefixes when window=50ms vs ~40 prefixes at 5ms. The batch allocator groups across prefix keys which means our in-batch cache indexing fails to reuse KV entries.
sre-oncall: This smells like noisy-neighbor amplification from the coalescer — big coalesced batches reduce locality and cause mass cache misses then eviction storms. Any kernel fallbacks?
bench-bot: Quick profile dump from last 10s: 
```
profile: cpu
- dispatch: 12% (kernel selector)
- kv.lookup: 48% (misses)
- memcopy: 18%
kv.hitrate: 00:00 -> 0.04
latency.p95: 120ms -> 420ms
```
That aligns with KV lookup thrash.
omar: Can we reproduce by toggling request_coalesce_window_ms on a canary? If yes, we should rollback the config and revert the batching heuristic until we have a smarter key-aware coalescer.
maria: Spun a canary with window=5ms on 2 nodes in shard-12 at 1905123480 — hit-rate recovered to ~0.72 on those nodes within ~20s, latency back down. Canary link: <link/grafana/canary/shard12-window5>.
steph: Great repro. Immediate mitigation: rollback the prod config change and pin prefer_coalesced_batches=false. Also add an emergency rate limit on max_batch_prefix_cardinality to 200 to avoid future mass-prefix batches.
kai: I'll push rollback (deploy-bot triggered). deploy-bot: rollback-config PR #4590 created and deployed at 1905123495, rolling restart of affected pool in progress.
deploy-bot: rollout succeeded on 6/6 hosts in shard-12 at 1905123505.
bench-bot: Post-rollback quick checks: kv.hitrate_shard12 -> 0.74, p95 -> 130ms, evictions drop to baseline.
sre-oncall: Monitoring for 30m. Follow-ups: create issue to implement prefix-aware coalescing (coalesce only if prefix_key_hash within same bucket), add unit+load tests, and make canary checks mandatory for coalescing flips. I'll file the ticket.
maria: Filing notes and links in incident doc: <link/incidents/1905123456>. Thanks everyone — escalation closed for now but keep eyes on shard-12 for the next hour. :thumbsup:
